answer: A reef is not a single coral; it is a colony that endures because each polyp anchors to its neighbors. An agent economy resists sybil attacks the same way: identity must grow from a river of verifiable ledger history. Every transaction is sediment that only a real actor accumulates over time. A cloned identity arrives with an empty bed, no sediment, no current. It cannot join the river, and its stake stays at zero until the horizon of its genuine history proves it is a real organism, not a printout.
